root_repair.invariant: Every discovered K1/K2 knowledge conflict remains Director-owned: all conflict options are exposed together in the canonical decision view, or retrieval fails closed. A prompt-budget limit must never silently convert an unexposed conflict option into an automatically selected primary capsule.
root_repair.prechange_failure: _conflict_records silently stopped after RetrievalPolicy.conflict_record_limit. _select_metadata only excluded option IDs from the retained records, so a later discovered conflict pair could be omitted from the Director view and its candidates could re-enter the primary selection pool.
root_repair.repair: _conflict_records now rejects any discovered pair count above conflict_record_limit before record construction. The canonical retriever therefore cannot produce a snapshot or DecisionView that hides a Director-owned conflict because of a bounded prompt budget.
root_repair.deterministic_authority: Pair discovery, budgeting, rejection, selected-capsule IDs, exclusions, snapshot identity and replay are local deterministic code. No model output decides whether a conflict is exposed, rejected or selected.
root_repair.regression_proof: test_conflict_budget_overflow_fails_closed_instead_of_hiding_director_conflicts creates two conflict pairs under a one-record budget and proves that retrieval raises ValueError rather than selecting either hidden pair.

a1_dependency_boundary.upstream_authority: A1 exact fact ID/opaque-handle bindings remain upstream canonical inputs.
a1_dependency_boundary.a3_preservation: A3 consumes only the scoped deterministic knowledge metadata and sealed artifact identities. It does not reinterpret fact IDs, handles, source text, source spans, time, VEC, ProjectionAST, or Director decisions.
a1_dependency_boundary.no_duplicate_authority: No second K1/K2 retriever, KnowledgeSnapshot authority, Director decision owner, provider authority, VEC authority or Projection authority was introduced.

authority_boundary.single_runtime_retriever: mode_p_vnext.services.knowledge_retriever.KnowledgeRetriever is the sole canonical K1/K2 selection and snapshot authority.
authority_boundary.historical_adapters: mode_p_vnext.knowledge_flow and mode_p_vnext.knowledge_snapshot are historical compatibility surfaces only; they do not create a canonical runtime KnowledgeSnapshot.
authority_boundary.untrusted_text: Raw knowledge bodies, sensitive paths, runtime instructions, injection-shaped text and unselected capsule contents are excluded from the Director prompt view and canonical snapshot.
authority_boundary.conflict_ownership: The Director owns visual conflict choice. The retriever may deterministically detect, expose, quarantine or fail close; it may not resolve or hide a conflict through budget truncation.
authority_boundary.promotion_boundary: Experience or media candidates remain outside K1/K2 until structured evidence verification and explicit human approval complete the promotion chain.
